name: Show data root selection better
description:
Whenever I open Rowbly in a directory that does not have rowbly initialized, I am presented with a screen to initialize the repo.

- If the user has existing data roots in their `.rowblyrc.json` file (home folder) then display a list to select a data root with an option at the bottom to initialize a new data root

- When user clicks to init new data root, shows the same onboarding screen for current folder that it shows today.

- The default data root should always be at the top of the list.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Factory decisions from sunny: TUI startup must show the picker whenever the current directory has no discoverable Data Root, even when a default exists. List the default first, other registered roots next, and New Data Root last. CLI resolution remains unchanged. Show this picker before incomplete global onboarding; selecting a root continues applicable onboarding, and New Data Root opens existing setup. The user authorizes amending ADR-0033 through a new repository ADR and updating its Status/index.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 3. Branch codex/row-46-startup-data-roots, based on current origin/main. Plan: add a TUI-only startup picker before onboarding when no directory Data Root is discoverable; default first, registered roots next, New Data Root last. Preserve CLI resolution, use existing activation/setup flows, update ADR and user/agent docs, run all four checks and capture real TUI screenshots. Shared interfaces are startup routing, Home Config reads, and Data Root activation; no Shell or Preferences redesign.
